'''Mary K. Carroll Mahony''' (born 1964) is an American chemist.

Carroll was born in [[Massachusetts]] in 1964, and raised in [[upstate New York]].<ref name="isgsspotlight">{{cite news |title=People in the Spotlight – Professor Mary K Carroll |url=https://www.isgs.org/community/people-in-the-spotlight-professor-lorena-betancor-2/ |access-date=20 July 2024 |publisher=International Sol-Gel Society}}</ref> She earned a bachelor's degree from [[Union College]] in 1986,<ref name="isgsspotlight"/><ref name="unionfacultypage">{{cite news |title=MARY K. CARROLL '86 |url=https://www.union.edu/chemistry/faculty-staff/mary-k-carroll |access-date=20 July 2024 |publisher=Union College}}</ref> followed by a doctorate at [[Indiana University Bloomington]] in 1991 before conducting postdoctoral research at the [[University of Massachusetts Amherst]].<ref name="isgsspotlight"/><ref name="acsgov">{{cite news |title=Mary K. Carroll President-Elect |url=https://www.acs.org/about/governance/board/mary-carroll.html |publisher=American Chemical Society}}</ref> She returned to Union College in 1992 as a faculty member, receiving successive promotions from assistant to associate and full professor in 1998 and 2005.<ref name="isgsspotlight"/> Carroll became Union's Dwane W. Crichton Professor of Chemistry in 2017.<ref name="isgsspotlight"/><ref name="unionfacultypage"/> In returning to Union College, Carroll was the first Union alumna to be hired as a tenure-track professor by her alma mater.<ref name="unionacspres">{{cite news |title=Prof. Mary Carroll '86 announced as ACS President Elect |url=https://www.union.edu/news/stories/202210/prof-mary-carroll-86-elected-acs-president-elect |access-date=20 July 2024 |date=26 October 2022}}</ref>

Carroll joined the [[American Chemical Society]] (ACS) as a member in 1986,<ref name="acsgov"/> began serving as councilor of the Eastern New York ACS section in 1998,<ref name="carrollunionalumniprofile">{{cite news |title=MARY K. (CARROLL) MAHONY '86 |url=https://www.union.edu/making-our-mark/stories/1980s/mary-k-carroll-mahony-86 |access-date=20 July 2024 |publisher=Union College}}</ref> and was elected an ACS fellow in 2016,<ref name="unionacsfellow">{{cite news |title=Professor Mary Carroll named American Chemical Society Fellow |url=https://www.union.edu/news/stories/201607/professor-mary-carroll-named-american-chemical-society-fellow |access-date=20 July 2024 |publisher=Union College |date=20 July 2016}}</ref> before serving as ACS president-elect and president in 2023 and 2024, respectively.<ref>{{cite journal |title=For president-elect Mary K. Carroll |journal=Chemical & Engineering News |volume=98 |issue=34 |url=https://cen.acs.org/acs-news/elections/For-president-elect-Mary-K-Carroll/98/i34}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=Mary K. Carroll wants to invite more people in |url=https://cen.acs.org/acs-news/Mary-K-Carroll-wants-invite/102/i1 |access-date=20 July 2024 |journal=Chemical & Engineering News |issue=1 |volume=102 |date=5 January 2024}}</ref>

Carroll's husband Michael Mahony and two daughters have also graduated from Union College.<ref name="carrollunionalumniprofile"/>
